item.title: The Elder Scrolls Online Team Will Outline Update 50's Player Experience Improvements This Week
item.description: The Elder Scrolls Online team is set to unveil player experience changes and improvements ahead in Update 50.

item.title: Soulframe Removing Fey Pact XP in Preludes 14, Which Gets a Preview Devstream This Week
item.description: Digital Extremes will remove XP earned in Soulframe from the discontinued Fey Pact in Preludes 14, which gets a preview later this week.

item.title: Brew Day is Back in EverQuest, With New Quests and Returning Content
item.description: Brew Day is back in EverQuest, and this year's event features new quest content and a new collection, as well as festive returning stuff to do.

item.title: Albion Online is Launching on Xbox in April, With Expanded Controller Support and Full Cross-Progression
item.description: Albion Online's upcoming Xbox launch now has a release date. The fantasy sandbox MMORPG will land on console in April.

item.title: GDC 2026: EverQuest Legends Aims To Recreate Classic EverQuest, But More Approachable For New Players
item.description: EverQuest was released back in 1999, and its hardcore MMO experience is still around today. EverQuest Legends is a new spin-off by Daybreak that aims to recreate that original experience, but in a more approachable, soloable way.

item.title: The Ever-Daunting EVE Online Introduces Newbie-Focused Player Region Where PvP Is Outright Barred
item.description: The sci-fi sandbox MMORPG will introduce a newcomer-dedicated region called Exordium for new players to learn the ropes--and it's fully anti-PvP.

item.title: Lost Ark's April Update, 'The Shadows Rise' Brings a New Threat and New Challenges Tomorrow
item.description: Lost Ark's latest update, "The Shadows Rise" is coming tomorrow. The April update adds our post-Kazeros threat: Primordial Beings. Take on the first Shadow Raid, new Chaos Rift and Haal's Hourglass, a new Guardian Raid, and of course, earn new rewards.

item.title: BEACN Announces Its First Headset, Which Will Start Shipping Later This Spring
item.description: BEACN has announced its first headset, the aptly named BEACN Headset, which aims to bring high-quality voice comms and polished audio to gamers, creators, or simply headphone lovers everywhere.

item.title: Update 50, and Some Season One Content, Now on The Elder Scrolls Online PTS
item.description: The Elder Scrolls Online is now testing Update 50 (and some Season One content) on the PTS.

item.title: Pirate Survival Sandbox Windrose Has Sailed Into PC Early Access Today
item.description: Windrose, the massive open-world pirate survival game from Kraken Express, has officially sailed into Early Access today, bringing its swashbuckling naval battles and survival gameplay to Steam, Epic Games Store and Stove.

item.title: Last Flag, The Capture The Flag Multiplayer Shooter By Night Street Games, Is Now Live On PC
item.description: The debut effort from indie dev Night Street Games, Last Flag, is now live on PC, bringing its capture-the-flag shooter and its alternate '70s-inspired setting to players on Steam and the Epic Games Store.

item.title: Warhammer Classics Release Brings 20+ Classic Warhammer Titles to Steam, Some for the First Time
item.description: A "Warhammer Classics" collection release from SNEG, in partnership with Games Workshop, brings more than 20 classic Warhammer games to a "future-proofed"modern PC release on Steam.

item.title: Learn More About Eterspire's Unlucky Cult And Help Witches Again In Today's Biweekly Patch
item.description: A new biweekly content update for the indie MMORPG is on its way, with new lower-level quests that expands the early game's lore.

item.title: Sky: Children of the Light's New Update Gets More Social With 'Presence' and Multiplayer Memory Features
item.description: The social MMO adventure game is introducing features to make it feel even more social.

item.title: Erenshor Celebrates First Anniversary With a Look Back, and Info on What's in the Next Patch
item.description: Erenshor, the single-player simulated MMORPG, is celebrating its first anniversary, so the game's dev is looking back and telling us what's next.
